scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:staff
scripts.test:db: psql "${DATABASE_URL:-$(pass show env/q3-interiors/DATABASE_URL)}" -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -o /dev/null -f supabase/tests/access.sql -f supabase/tests/booking.sql -f supabase/tests/changes.sql -f supabase/tests/hardening.sql -f supabase/tests/roles.sql -f supabase/tests/business.sql -f supabase/tests/wording.sql -f supabase/tests/campaigns.sql -f supabase/tests/checklist.sql -f supabase/tests/ads.sql -f supabase/tests/ads_review.sql -f supabase/tests/form_v2.sql -f supabase/tests/prepare.sql -f supabase/tests/pilot.sql -f supabase/tests/outcomes.sql -f supabase/tests/by_ad.sql -f supabase/tests/ads_campaigns.sql -f supabase/tests/notes.sql -f supabase/tests/website.sql -f supabase/tests/book_call.sql -f supabase/tests/estimates.sql -f supabase/tests/work_items.sql -f supabase/tests/after_call.sql -f supabase/tests/quotes.sql -c begin -f supabase/forms/published.sql -c rollback && supabase/tests/race.sh && scripts/check-anon-http.sh && echo 'database checks passed'
scripts.functions:check: cd supabase/functions && deno check --config deno.jsonc public-booking/index.ts booking-worker/index.ts calendar-admin/index.ts google-oauth-callback/index.ts staff-booking/index.ts staff-accounts/index.ts
scripts.build:staff: VITE_SURFACE=staff vite build --outDir dist-staff && node scripts/staff-site-files.cjs
